info.title: Stockland Ethiopia ERP REST API
info.description: REST route reference generated from the installer-bound Stockland ERP 16.2.18 source commit 1f796f46ad840384e6d1601f307401e98842e1b5. The namespace is stockland/v16. The route inventory was checked against all 23 REST controller files in that exact source tree. This is not a live server scan: where WordPress route registration does not declare a full JSON schema, request and response shapes are intentionally described as endpoint-specific rather than guessed. Authorization is enforced by WordPress and Stockland ERP permission callbacks.

servers.description: Replace the host variable with the approved Stockland ERP production hostname before using the API playground.

host.description: Approved Stockland ERP host only; do not use a development or preview host.

tags.name: App & Command Center
tags.description: ERP bootstrap, dashboard, search, notifications, workflow history, audit and operational control.

tags.name: Users & Access
tags.description: ERP user listing and management. Access remains subject to endpoint permission checks.

tags.name: Product Master
tags.description: Product and SKU lookup, create/update and variant operations.

tags.name: Retail POS
tags.description: Retail sales, POS cart submission and sale/daily closing actions.

tags.name: Inventory & Counts
tags.description: Stock, reorder status and daily inventory reporting.

tags.name: Finance & Procurement
tags.description: Suppliers, customers, purchase orders, invoices, expenses, payments and general ledger reporting.

tags.name: HR & Payroll (restricted)
tags.description: HR and payroll source-registered routes. Separately gated features and effective-dated statutory settings apply; the presence of a route does not certify a workflow as activated for routine production use.

tags.name: Import Jobs
tags.description: Daily POS import, Product Master import, mapping and code-map jobs. Upload, preview, review and commit steps remain distinct.

tags.name: Management Intelligence
tags.description: Management social campaign and snapshot reporting.

tags.name: Receiving
tags.description: PO-linked receipt listing and completion. This reference does not document free-form inventory receipts.

tags.name: Requisitions & Transfers
tags.description: Requisition and transfer workflows, decisions, receiving and warehouse actions.

tags.name: System & Diagnostics
tags.description: Setup status and controlled setup advancement.

tags.name: Wholesale
tags.description: Wholesale advice and wholesale order submission.
